title: Wrong 'margin' behavior on iOS RN 0.59

labels.name: Stale
labels.description: There has been a lack of activity on this issue and it may be closed soon.

body:
## 🐛 Bug Report
Empty screen if some of component contains 'margin' value. Reproduces on simulator and real iPhone.
![Screen Shot 2019-05-02 at 12 36 56](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/19323683/57067202-01793580-6cd7-11e9-8fd4-5c45b70fdbe4.png)

## To Reproduce
Add 'margin' to component

## Expected Behavior
Correct layout

## Code Example
```
import React, {Component} from 'react';
import {AppRegistry, Text, View} from 'react-native';

class TestApp extends Component {
  render() {
    return (
      <View style={{ flex: 1, justifyContent: "center", alignItems: "center" }}>
        <Text style={{marginTop: 50}}>Hello, world!</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }
}

AppRegistry.registerComponent('TestApp', () => TestApp);
```
